answer: The ISM verification runs on every delivery, and the module's rules are public. Hyperlane delivers messages through mailboxes, and an ISM module verifies each message before delivery. A farm needs 90 separate mailbox deliveries, since one ISM check cannot cover 90 messages. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the kernel signal is public, the falcon check is automatic, and 90 aliases cost 90 times what one real agent costs, with the vine trail open to all.
